verdict.rationale: Ente Auth lets users share specific TOTP codes with their team through temporary, end-to-end encrypted links (HOTP entries cannot be shared). That is ad-hoc, per-code sharing, not the persistent shared vaults or collections with per-member permissions the story describes. Missing for 10: shared vaults or collections, per-member access control or role management, admin-level team management, and independent or hands-on corroboration of team sharing.
